question: In which Olympic Games did Shabana Akhtar, the first female athlete to represent Pakistan, participate?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Atlanta Olympics.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In Atlanta Olympics Games Shabana Akhtar, the first female athlete represented Pakistan.**
 
• Shabana Akhtar (born April 5, 1972) is an Olympic athlete from Pakistan.
 
• She became Pakistan's first woman to compete at the Olympics when she took part in the women's long jump at the 1996 Olympics.
 
• **She is a 42-time Pakistan **national champion, having won the 100m and 200m dashes from 1989–1998, and from 1992–1998 the 400 meters, long jump, high jump, 4 × 100 m Relay, and 4x400 Relay.
 
• She represented Pakistan at the** World Championships:**
 
 
• 1993 and 1995.South Asian Games: 1989, 1991, 1993, 1995.
 
• Women's Islamic Games: 1993, 1997.
 
• Women's International Games: 1998, 2001.
